note: Adapted from Emerson 1925; original in English; the OCR is largely clear, and the measurements are in mm as stated in the original. The original lists this species as Nasutitermes (Constrictotermes) cavifrons.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brownish black, sparsely covered with rather long hairs, broadly oval. Fontanelle slit-like, forked at the tip, as long as the ocelli. Antennae paler than the head, 15-segmented, segment 2 as long as segment 4, segment 3 more than twice as long as segment 2. Compound eyes large and protruding, close to the lower margin of the head; ocelli large and protruding, about their own length from the compound eyes. Labrum paler than the head. Postclypeus brownish black, without a distinct median line. Pronotum paler than the head, sparsely covered with rather long hairs; large, as wide as or nearly as wide as the head, sides and angles rounded, posterior margin very shallowly concave. Posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum deeply concave. Wings dark smoky, veins distinct. Abdomen brownish black; in life the membranous part of the abdomen of the physogastric female tinged with yellow. Measurements: length with wings 17.00—19.00 mm, length without wings 8.00—10.00 mm, head length 1.83—1.90 mm, head width 1.69—1.83 mm, antennal length 2.53—2.57 mm, eye diameter 0.50—0.53 mm, pronotum length 1.00—1.03 mm, pronotum width 1.73—1.83 mm, hind tibia length 2.16—2.43 mm, forewing length 13.50—15.00 mm, forewing width 3.76—4.11 mm; body length of the physogastric female 18.00 mm, abdominal width 4.20 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brownish black, the region around the antennae paler; with a strong constriction at the middle; 4 setae at the base of the rostral process and several more on the vertex. Antennae with dark rings, nearly concolorous with the head, very long, 15-segmented, segment 3 nearly twice as long as segment 2, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3, segment 5 as long as segment 3. Rostral process upturned, paler than the head at the tip. Thorax yellow; pronotum with a few setae, the anterior margin with fine hairs. Legs relatively very long; coxae and tarsi yellow, femora and the parts of the tibiae near the femora darker. Abdominal tergites brownish black, with numerous setae and a few hairs; sternites yellow, hairy, with marginal rows of setae. Measurements: body length 5.00—5.50 mm, head length 1.56—1.70 mm, head width 1.00—1.12 mm, antennal length 3.40—3.58 mm, pronotum width 0.67—0.70 mm, hind tibia length 2.00—2.27 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality: Suriname. Emerson collected it at Kartabo, Bartica and Dunoon in British Guiana; distribution: Suriname and British Guiana. The description is based on many alates, kings, queens and soldiers from eight different nests at Kartabo, and on soldiers from one nest each at Bartica (collected by G. E. Bodkin) and Dunoon (collected by F. M. Gaige). In Emerson's paper the species is placed under the subgenus Constrictotermes of Nasutitermes.
